ud6.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
ud6.8:1.3: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe dve pūgā aññatarissā gaṇikāya sārattā honti paṭibaddhacittā
ud6.8:1.4: bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ pāṇīhi pi upakkamanti leḍḍūhi pi upakkamanti daṇḍehi pi upakkamanti satthehi pi upakkamanti.
ud6.8:1.5: te tattha maraṇam pi nigacchanti maraṇamattam pi dukkhaṃ.
ud6.8:2.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃsu,
ud6.8:2.2: Rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
ud6.8:2.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud6.8:4.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud6.8:5.1: yañ ca pattaṃ yañ ca pattabbaṃ, ubhayam etaṃ rajānukiṇṇaṃ āturass' anusikkhato
ud6.8:5.2: yeva sikkhāsārā. sīlabbataṃ jīvitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ sārā , ayam eko anto
ud6.8:5.4: evaṃdiṭṭhino. n' atthi kāmesu doso 'ti ayaṃ dutiyo anto.
ud6.8:5.5: icc' ete ubho antā kaṭasivaḍḍhanā, kaṭasiyo diṭṭhī vaḍḍhenti.
ud6.8:5.6: ete te ubho ante anabhiññāya olīyanti eke, atidhāvanti eke;
ud6.8:5.7: ye ca kho te abhiññāya tatra ca n' āhesuṃ te na ca amaññiṃsu, vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n' atthi paññāpanāyā
